conditions.displayName: A phone sent a diagnostic at ERROR or above

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="whim-server" AND logName:"run.googleapis.com%2Fstdout" AND jsonPayload.scope="device" AND severity>=ERROR

documentation.content: A phone reported an error. At most one email per hour: read them all in Logs Explorer with `resource.type="cloud_run_revision" resource.labels.service_name="whim-server" jsonPayload.scope="device" severity>=ERROR` (docs/deploy.md, Operating: Alerts).
